question: Have you enrolled on AUSTRAC's Reporting Entity Roll? (The deadline for enrolment was 29 July 2026)
Have you conducted a risk assessment covering your services, customers, channels, jurisdictions and employee risk?
Do you have written AML/CTF policies appropriate to your nature, size and complexity?
Has a senior manager approved your program, with ongoing oversight by your governing body?
Have you appointed a fit and proper AML/CTF compliance officer at management level?
Do you identify and verify each customer before providing a designated service?
Do you monitor customers and transactions on an ongoing basis for suspicious activity?
Can you lodge suspicious matter reports within 3 business days and threshold transaction reports for cash of $10,000 or more within 10 business days?
Do you keep records for 7 years, with personnel due diligence and AML/CTF training in place?
Is an independent evaluation of your program scheduled at least every 3 years?
